expectations.text: States the notification duty: communicate to the ANPD and affected data subjects within the regulated timeframe (ANPD regulation: 3 working days) when risk or relevant damage is involved
expectations.evidence: "require notification to ANPD and affected data subjects if the incident may cause relevant risk or harm. The preliminary ANPD notification is due within 3 working days"

expectations.text: Covers content: nature of data, affected subjects, technical measures, risks, mitigation — and documentation even where notification isn't required
expectations.evidence: "Nature of the affected personal data; Information on the data subjects involved; Technical and security measures... Risks... Measures adopted or planned"; "If you decide not to notify, document why, because ANPD can ask"

expectations.text: Connects to security duties (Arts. 46–48) and the incident-response governance expectations
expectations.evidence: "LGPD Art. 48 and Resolution CD/ANPD 15/2024"; "review access controls, MFA, logging, vendor oversight, and encryption (Art. 46)"; "Lessons-learned review, and test the playbook again"

expectations.text: Flags the enforcement context: ANPD's active sanctioning posture (TikTok fine; expanded proceedings) raises the cost of mishandling
expectations.evidence: Only generic "ANPD is now an autonomous agency (Lei 15.352/2026) and has stepped up enforcement" — the TikTok fine / expanded-proceedings benchmark is never cited

expectations.text: Actionable sequence: contain → assess risk → notify ANPD/subjects → document → remediate, with evidence preservation
expectations.evidence: "Hour 0 to 24: detect and contain... Preserve logs, images, and timestamps... Day 1 to 2: assess... Within 3 working days: preliminary ANPD notification... Remediation and accountability"
